From b9ddd5091160793ee9fac10da765cf3f53d2aaf0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jacopo Mondi <jacopo+renesas@jmondi.org>
Date: Mon, 5 Aug 2019 17:55:15 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] iio: adc: max9611: Fix temperature reading in probe

The max9611 driver reads the die temperature at probe time to validate
the communication channel. Use the actual read value to perform the test
instead of the read function return value, which was mistakenly used so
far.

The temperature reading test was only successful because the 0 return
value is in the range of supported temperatures.

Fixes: 69780a3bbc0b ("iio: adc: Add Maxim max9611 ADC driver")
Signed-off-by: Jacopo Mondi <jacopo+renesas@jmondi.org>
Cc: <Stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>

diff --git a/drivers/iio/adc/max9611.c b/drivers/iio/adc/max9611.c
index 0e3c6529fc4c..da073d72f649 100644
--- a/drivers/iio/adc/max9611.c
+++ b/drivers/iio/adc/max9611.c
@@ -480,7 +480,7 @@ static int max9611_init(struct max9611_dev *max9611)
 	if (ret)
 		return ret;
 
-	regval = ret & MAX9611_TEMP_MASK;
+	regval &= MAX9611_TEMP_MASK;
 
 	if ((regval > MAX9611_TEMP_MAX_POS &&
 	     regval < MAX9611_TEMP_MIN_NEG) ||
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/iio/adc/max9611.c`**
- The line that previously assigned the return value of a function to `regval` has been modified. Instead of using `regval = ret & MAX9611_TEMP_MASK;`, it now uses `regval &= MAX9611_TEMP_MASK;`. This change ensures that the actual read value is used for the temperature reading test rather than the return value of the read function.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug in the temperature reading validation during the probe of the max9611 driver. The previous implementation incorrectly used the return value of the read function, which could lead to false positives in the temperature reading test. By using the actual read value, the driver can more accurately validate the communication channel, thus fixing the issue. This change is crucial for ensuring the reliability of the temperature readings from the max9611 ADC driver.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
ret = max9611_read_single(max9611, CONF_TEMP, &regval);
regval = ret & MAX9611_TEMP_MASK;
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the return value `ret` from the `max9611_read_single` function is incorrectly used to validate the temperature reading instead of the actual value stored in `regval`. If `ret` returns 0 (indicating success), it could mislead the validation process, as it does not reflect the actual temperature reading, which could be invalid.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
regval &= MAX9611_TEMP_MASK;
```
Reason:
This change ensures that the actual value read from the device (`regval`) is masked correctly to filter out any irrelevant bits, allowing for proper validation of the temperature reading. By using `regval` instead of `ret`, the code now accurately checks the actual temperature value against the defined limits, preventing incorrect validation results.
